steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Stakeholders: any person or group with an interest in a business. Internal: owners, employees, managers. External: customers, suppliers, local community, government, pressure groups. | Key Fact: Stakeholder objectives often conflict: owners want maximum profit (low wages, high prices); employees want higher wages and better conditions; customers want low prices and high quality; local community wants jobs but less pollution; government wants tax revenue and compliance. | Key Fact: Managing stakeholder conflict: compromise, negotiation, prioritisation.
